newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT-Merrill ups Wharf to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Merrill ups Wharf to buy.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said it had upgraded its intermediate term recommendation for Wharf Holdings Ltd to buy from accumulate.
"Wharf has underperformed the Hang Seng Index by 15 percent over the last three months," Merrill Lynch said in a report dated April 18.

"It is now trading at a 40 percent discount to our estimated net asset value versus a property investors' average of 39 percent, although historically Wharf has traded at a narrower discount than the sector."
Property development profit was forecast to rise to HK$1.2 billion in 1997 and HK$2.7 billion in 1998 even if prices were 10 to 20 percent below prevailing prices, it said.
It forecast a decline in operating losses at Wharf Cable TV from HK$580 million in 1996 to around HK$480 million in 1997 and HK$120 million in 1998.
Merrill Lynch also forecast all-in earnings per share growth of 20 percent in 1997, and 72 percent in 1998.
It predicted volumes would pick up at Wharf's 50.8 percent owned Modern Terminals Ltd after declines in throughput in the first two months of the year.
